label: Kunoichi
description: a slim, agile female ninja (kunoichi): long black high ponytail, dark purple sleeveless short ninja jacket over a mesh undershirt, a long flowing red scarf, black cloth wraps on the forearms and shins, dark fitted trousers, split-toe tabi boots, a dark grey cloth mask covering her nose and mouth, a short steel kunai held reverse-grip in each hand

portrait.prompt: Using the attached character reference exactly (same character: {description}), draw a square character-select portrait in the same pixel-art style: chest-up close-up, the face large with a calm, sharp, focused expression, the head turned three-quarters toward the left, one kunai raised beside the face in a reverse grip, the red scarf and ponytail flowing behind, dramatic rim lighting. Solid dark crimson-purple background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A light, bouncy ready stance on the balls of the feet. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; the body bobs gently, the scarf and ponytail sway.
poses: rest pose: low ready stance, knees bent, both kunai held reverse-grip in front of the chest, scarf hanging behind
body bobs down about 2 pixels, shoulders relaxed, scarf starts to drift back
lowest point of the bob, knees a little more bent, ponytail swings forward
rising back up, kunai hands shift slightly, scarf flutters
highest point, up on the balls of the feet about 2 pixels above rest, ponytail swings back
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A quick, light-footed stalking walk toward the LEFT, staying low. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place); only the legs, a small body bob, scarf and ponytail move. Kunai stay held in front.
poses: contact: front (left) foot reaching forward on its toes, back foot behind, body low
down: weight moves onto the front foot, knees bend, body dips about 2 pixels
passing: back leg sweeps forward past the planted leg, scarf trailing
contact, opposite leg: the other foot reaching forward on its toes (mirror of frame 1)
down, opposite leg: weight onto the new front foot, body dips (mirror of frame 2)
passing, opposite leg: back leg sweeps forward, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A light retreating step: she keeps FACING LEFT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the right) on her toes. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: back (right) foot placed behind on its toes, front foot flat, body leaning slightly back, kunai in guard
down: weight shifts onto the back foot, knees bend slightly
passing: front foot slides back past the other foot
contact, opposite leg (mirror of frame 1)
down, opposite leg (mirror of frame 2)
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Feet stay on the same ground line; the body lowers. The final crouch is about 55 percent of the standing height.
poses: ready stance, same as the reference
knees bending, body lowering about a quarter of its height
deep bend, one knee nearly touching the ground, kunai held low
full low crouch held, one knee down, body about 55 percent of standing height, kunai ready, head looking left
kneeling, held
kneeling, held

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line (feet about a third of the body height above it). Keep her horizontally centred in her cell.
poses: anticipation: low crouch, knees deeply bent, arms back, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, body stretched upward, feet just leaving the ground line
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked, scarf streaming below
apex: highest point, tight front-flip tuck, body curled into a ball
falling: uncurling, legs extending downward, arms out for balance
landing: feet back on the ground line, crouched low absorbing the impact, one hand touching the ground

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: ready stance, starting to raise both forearms
both forearms crossed in front of the face, kunai blades pointing outward
block held: forearms crossed in an X in front of the face and chest, body braced, knees bent
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace (held)
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace (held)

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the same ground line; the body is crouched. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: ready stance, starting to crouch
crouching, forearms lowering in front of the knees
block held: low crouch, forearms crossed in an X in front of the shins, kunai pointing down
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace (held)
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace (held)

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Being struck in the face from the LEFT: the reaction pushes her back to the RIGHT. Feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut, torso jerks back, arms flung out
maximum recoil: torso bent well back, one foot sliding, scarf whipping forward
recovering: leaning back less, grimacing, weight returning forward
almost recovered: back near the ready stance with a pained face
almost recovered: back near the ready stance with a pained face (held)
almost recovered: back near the ready stance with a pained face (held)

actions.label: Kunai Jab
actions.note: A very fast straight kunai thrust toward the LEFT at chest height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: ready stance, front kunai pulled back slightly
wind-up: front arm drawn back beside the chest, shoulders twisting
thrust: front arm shooting forward at chest height, body leaning in
full extension: arm and kunai fully extended forward to the left at chest height, a short white slash streak at the tip
pulling the arm back, body still leaning forward
recovery: back to the ready stance

actions.label: Sweep Kick
actions.note: A powerful low spinning sweep kick toward the LEFT, aimed at the opponent's shins. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: ready stance, weight shifting onto the back leg, dropping low
deep crouch, one hand planted on the ground, body starting to spin, the kicking leg pulled in
sweep: the kicking leg swinging out low and fast to the left, a motion arc behind the foot
full extension: the leg fully extended forward to the left near the ground at shin height, scarf whipping around
follow-through: the leg sweeping past, body still low and turning
recovery: rising back to the ready stance

actions.label: Shadow Seal
actions.note: She powers up in place; feet stay planted. A purple shadow aura grows from faint to intense.
poses: ready stance, hands coming together in front of the chest
hands forming a ninja seal in front of the face, eyes closed, a faint purple aura appearing
aura stronger, scarf and ponytail lifting upward, eyes opening
peak: intense purple shadow aura swirling around her body, kunai glowing, ready to strike
peak: intense purple shadow aura swirling around her body, kunai glowing, ready to strike (held)
peak: intense purple shadow aura swirling around her body, kunai glowing, ready to strike (held)

actions.label: Shadow Flurry
actions.note: A three-hit dashing kunai combo toward the LEFT. The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transition frames between hits. Purple shadow after-images trail her.
poses: wind-up: very low dash stance, both kunai drawn back, purple aura
dashing forward to the left, body almost horizontal, purple after-image behind
first hit: a wide horizontal slash with the front kunai at chest height, a bright purple slash arc
transition: spinning, kunai pulled back across the body, after-images trailing
second hit: a reverse slash with the other kunai at chest height, a purple slash arc
transition: leaping slightly upward, both kunai raised high
third hit, the finisher: a big X-shaped double slash downward in front of her, a large purple X burst
follow-through: landing low, kunai crossed downward, sparks of shadow fading
recovery: rising back to the ready stance

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: She is hit from the LEFT and falls backward to the RIGHT, ending lying on her back with her head to the right and her feet to the left. The final frames are a held lying pose. The lying body must still fit inside its cell.
poses: hit reaction: head snaps back, torso jerks back
airborne: leaning back at about 45 degrees, both feet off the ground, arms flung wide
falling: body nearly horizontal, legs kicked up, scarf flying
hitting the ground on her back, impact, dust puff
lying flat on her back, limp, head to the right, feet to the left, a kunai beside her
lying flat, identical to frame 5 (held pose)
lying flat (held)
lying flat (held)
lying flat (held)
